question: The eighth season of the Pro Kabaddi League was held at ________ in 2021-2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second half of **Pro Kabaddi Season 8 fixtures** between **January 21 to February 4.**
 
• Over the course of the** 14 days, 33 matches **will be contested in total.
 
• The competition will include **doubleheaders and triple headers** each day, much as the first half.
 
• **Pro Kabaddi Season 8 **matches will all take place in a **spectator-free environment **at the **Sheraton Grand Bengaluru Whitefield Hotel & Convention Centre. ​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The** men's professional Kabaddi league** in India is called **Pro Kabaddi League.**
 
• It debuted in** 2014 **and is televised by Star Sports.
 
• Due to the COVID-19 pandemic,** Season 8 was delayed**, and it finally started on December** 22, 2021.**
 
• It is a** franchise-based league.**
 
• It had** eight teams** that each paid entry fees of up to** US$250,000 to participate .**
 
• The **Jaipur Pink Panthers** won the inaugural Pro Kabaddi championship in **2014.**
 
• **Dabang Delhi K.C. defeated Patna Pirates 37-36 **to win their first PKL trophy in **Season 8, 2022.**
 
• **Naveen Kumar, **a two-time MVP, and** Vijay **each scored** Super 10s** in the championship game against the Patna Pirates**' Mohammadreza Chiyaneh-led defense.**​
